examples.description: Docs' own counter-example: identical report, but the Score levels are the digits 0/1/2 instead of descriptions. Jev splits probability 0.43/0.57 (score 0.57, confidence 0.35) where descriptive levels give score 0.0 at confidence 1.0. Evidence that Jev also scores digit levels 0..N-1, and that numeric-only levels are weak by construction.
